main_text.p: libentissimé vidi, & amanter sum complexus, cùm tui, vestræqve Congregatio-nis causa, tùm ob amicitiam, quæ á plurimis annis mihi cum eo est, cui propterea, quidquid á me Proficisci potest, ultro exhibui; cæterùm me velim, ut facis, amare pergas.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXXXII.
main_text.p: Card. Barberinus J. Morino significat' Criticam Sacram Lud. Cabelli materiâ disputationis Romæ suppeditasse, & cur non errores solùm, sed curiositatem omnem & audaciam, quibus ad novos errores via sternatur, depel-lere curent Romani Aulici.
Admodum Reverendo P. P. J. Morino Congr. Orat. Presbytero.
VIx tibi gratias egi ob præcipuam be-nevolentiam, quam in tuis literis ex-hibuisti, cum nova præberetur occasio & tibi per istam singularem tuam erudi-

page.notes: No marginal notes. Long s is rendered as s throughout. The initial "VIx" is a large woodcut-style V joined to the first word. The catchword "tio-" stands alone at lower right, below the last full line. The line "Card. Barberinus J. Morino" has a J that may be a printed "J." abbreviation; read as J. with reasonable confidence.
